projects.name: Sales Forecast Analysis (Apple)
details: • Working with apple to predict future customer demand for products or services of apple, used
several powerful python libraries and tools that can be used for demand forecasting analysis
i.e. NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn for time series forecasting doing Demand Forecast Analysis
of the products using historical data, doing prior analysis of a products like Order Shortage, Low
inventory, Continuous decline of sales of a products using Machine learning approach.
• Worked on  Data Preparation, Data Visualization understand the Patterns and trends in the
demand, Time Series Analysis:
• Performed time series analysis on the data, such as identifying seasonality, trend, and any other
relevant patterns.
• Worked on finding an appropriate forecasting model, such as ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated
Moving Average) or SARIMA (Seasonal ARIMA), based on the characteristics of the data. Splited
the data into training and testing sets to evaluate the model's performance.
• Trained the selected forecasting model on the training data. Evaluated the model's
performance on the testing data using appropriate metrics like Mean Absolute Error (MAE),
Mean Squared Error (MSE), or Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). Used the trained model to make predictions for future demand.
• Used Snowflake for data set accessing and Data lab for python script development. Using various
python libraries for Exploratory Data Analysis using Dtale, Pandas etc.
Jun 2020 – Machine Learning Engineer
March 2021  Chefling Inc, Bangalore

details: • Worked on data scrapping to generate  dataset for ingredient content extraction. Used

Question, QuAC.
